facts: Party: immutable tenant-scoped business actor with optional unique IdentifierSet
PrincipalRepresentation: principal + Party + half-open validity, recorded actor and reason
RepresentationRevocation: unique immutable terminal fact with effectiveAt
Person/Organization/Customer/Worker: typed consumer-owned satellites, not a foundation inheritance hierarchy
invariants: Business Party identity is independent of authentication, authorization and principal deprovisioning
Representation is many-to-many and tenant-scoped; no universal EntityRef or authority grant
Validity is half-open; unique revocation preserves historical interpretation
Unreadable revocation or Party fails closed; effective lookup preserves pagination cursor
Duplicate principal/party/start and competing revocations conflict atomically
Party and representation facts reject mutation/deletion; identifiers never replace canonical IDs
